Name: Inspired Leah
Author: Amstral
Description:
Sorry for taking so long in updating a new mod. I wasn´t feeling well and I didn´t wan´t to keep going with the modding project at all. BUT NOW IM BACK 😈
Thanks specially to @mangotoro :) 
I tried drawing the hair bandana guys, I swear, it looks a little bit weird lol

Btw if it doesn´t work for you I´ll upload the same version on xnb format. Let me know on the posts please.

Instructions:
1. Drop the file on the Mods folder frome the main game.
2. Done lol
Please remember to use a file extractor to unzip the file (winrar, 7z..)
